name: What causes mold to grow in an attic?

mainEntity.name: What causes mold to grow in an attic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold in attics is commonly caused by excessive moisture and poor ventilation. Common sources include roof leaks, condensation from unsealed penetrations (like exhaust fans or plumbing vents), and insufficient insulation that leads to temperature differences. Without proper airflow, trapped moisture creates an ideal environment for mold spores to thrive, leading to growth on wood, insulation, and other organic materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold in attics is caused by excessive moisture from leaks, condensation, or poor ventilation. Trapped moisture and lack of airflow create ideal conditions for mold growth.
